The series has strong trend/seasonality and unstable rankings; a robust trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier models.
test a weighted combination with softmax_neg_error to see if a different weighting scheme improves over inverse_error and mean, given unstable ranking and strong seasonality.
Test a robust median combination to reduce influence of highly correlated error groups given unstable ranking.
Try robust DBA over full pool to mitigate unstable ranking and correlated errors
test per‑horizon best model weighting on the selected stable pool
Try a weighted combination on the more stable pool4 using inverse_error weights to see if a simple error‑based weighting improves over mean while keeping subset robust.
The series has unstable rankings and strong trend/seasonality; a robust trimmed mean on a correlated‑error‑reduced pool may improve over mean.
Test a robust per‑horizon weighted combo on the reduced, stable pool (pool4) using softmax_neg_error to emphasize the best models per horizon while keeping diversity.
The series has unstable rankings (tau -0.185) and strong seasonality; a robust median over a correlated‑group subset (pool4) may reduce error variance.

The ranking is unstable and several models have correlated errors; a per‑horizon weighted combination may exploit complementary strengths across horizons. I will test a weighted combination using the per‑horizon top‑k weights handle (w7) over the full pool.

decision.justification: Selected 'mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 1.0. Series context: trend strength 1.0 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.185); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.755.
